description: SenseVoice-Small multilingual speech recognition with rich event/emotion/ITN tags via a SAN-M encoder and CTC head, ported to audio.cpp.

request.name: language
request.description: Recognition language, or auto to let the model infer it from the audio.

request.name: enable_itn
request.description: Enable inverse text normalization (adds the withitn query token).

request.name: keep_tags
request.description: Keep <|event|>/<|emotion|>/<|language|> tags inline in the output text.

request.name: audio_chunk_mode
request.description: Offline chunk mode: auto, fixed, vad, or none. Streaming always uses fixed-duration windows.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration_sec
request.description: Positive duration rounding to at least one sample; sets fixed windows and the VAD maximum chunk length.

session.name: encoder_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Encoder graph arena size in MB.

session.name: vad_model_path
session.description: Path to the Silero VAD model directory used by automatic audio chunking.

packages.description: audio.cpp GGUF built from the SenseVoice-Small checkpoint via the SenseVoice llama.cpp export script.

ui.summary: SenseVoice-Small transcription with event/emotion tags and ITN.
